reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the concept of local SFE fluctuations from compositional heterogeneity (P8, P31) with the idea of processing-controlled local chemical order (P4, P9, P14) to propose a direct, quantitative link between the amplitude of SFE fluctuations, twin nucleation density, and strain hardening/ductility. This specific causal chain and the proposed controlled comparison to test it are not stated in any single passage, representing a non-trivial integration of several sources into a new, testable proposal.
